note: Code derivation: data/goldberg_2018_escs.py melts DOP.tab with var_name='item' and renames nothing; BLOCK_NAMES[('dop','ai_')]='avocational_interests', so live codes ai_1..ai_209 ARE the source column names (core model s3 pattern 1). But the .sav's variable labels are bare ('Ai_1'..'Ai_209') and its value labels bare numbers 1..5, so the code->text tie is NOT data_labels: it rests on reading the 209 printed activities (unnumbered on the form) top-to-bottom, pp.7-15 (11+23x8+14), as ai_1..ai_209 -> mapping_basis=paper_order. Verified PARTIAL (verify_goldberg_2018_dop_avocational_interests.R): (B) the deposit's own scoring syntax DOP_scales.sps assigns 198 codes to 34 named scales; a keyword category read off the SHIPPED text agrees with the SPS scale of that code for 198/198 (text shifted +/-1..3: 0-2/198); (A) the item's highest mean-r text category in the live data is its own for 170/202 categorised items (random-permutation null median 0.037, max 0.109, observed 0.842); (C) the form prints 'Wrote poetry' twice and ai_82/ai_199 are each other's top correlate, r=0.90 (next highest 0.51); (D) nested pairs order correctly: ai_67 '...more than an hour thinking about what to wear' > ai_29 '...10 minutes...' for 0.8% of respondents vs 80.1% reverse; ai_61 'hour or more in a non-grocery store' > ai_19 '10 minutes or more' 2.4% vs 49.0%. Semantic markers: ai_5 'Washed dishes' mean 4.8, ai_25 'Watched television' 4.9, ai_156 'Raced a car, truck, or motorcycle' 1.3, ai_180 'Participated in an animal show' 1.3. Not established: order within a content category beyond the pinned pairs; 11 codes carry no SPS scale. Text: pdftotext -layout of DOP.pdf, spot-checked against renders of pp.7-8; each activity runs into dot leaders with no visible terminal punctuation, so none is shipped. Verbatim otherwise (e.g. 'Used an mp3 player or Ipod', 'Worked on a scrap book', 'Dined by candle light'). Option<->resp: printed scale box on p.7 labels 1..5 'Never in my life' / 'Not in the past year' / 'One or two times in the past year' / 'Three to ten times in the past year' / 'More than ten times in the past year' (the box's line breaks joined; option 3 prints 'in the past  year' with a layout double space, normalised to one). The script stores the .sav integers unchanged: .sav per-item x level counts equal live 1045/1045 cells (133,175 rows, 639 ids, from the local irw cache; no new export). instructions = the printed section lead-in, verbatim incl. trailing colon. instrument = section title + the technical report's description ('the 209 items measuring Goldberg's 32 preliminary avocational-interest scales') -- composed; the SPS actually computes 34 scales. One trivial section_id. Step 3b: dictionary 'avocational-interest items, resp 1-5, 639 x 209' matches the 209 printed activities and the 5-point frequency scale; the 90 vignettes on pp.1-7 are the sibling table goldberg_2018_dop_ab5c_vignettes. Rights: items authored for this study by Goldberg/ORI and published in Goldberg's own CC0 deposit; not a third-party commercial instrument; no restriction on the wording located or stated (silence). No register row written.
public_note: The questionnaire prints the activity 'Wrote poetry' twice (ai_82 and ai_199); the two codes are separate responses to identical wording (r = 0.90), not a transcription error.
